sourceProposalAgreement.interpretation: Exact agreement with 100 unreviewed development source proposals; no admitted linguistic labels.

pinnedWordTestDescriptiveAgreement.interpretation: Strict Unicode agreement with the same pinned 4101 source labels, unchanged at 281/4101. Public-test descriptive comparison without a clean held-out or population accuracy claim. Historical 279/4101 initial/loanword baselines remain separately recorded.

separationAudit.scope: Twelve exact lowercase Roman month keys and native outputs. Public Roman keys compare after lowercase conversion; native outputs compare both exactly and after NFC plus removal of U+200C/U+200D. Cohort word Roman keys/native source proposals compare exactly after Roman lowercase; Roman sentence tokens use /[a-z]+/gi. No native sentence-substring overlap assertion.
separationAudit.restriction: No external rows filtered or relabeled; no raw external reference text redistributed.

implementationScope: Twelve lexicon entries and two explicit month Title Case aliases in src/index.js constructor setup; conversion/tokenization function bodies unchanged. No suffix rules, abbreviations, blanket all-caps fold, calendar/digit conversion or API added.
limits: Selected CLDR spellings are source-assisted project defaults, without independent human review or a universal orthography claim.
All 87 prior fixture rows and their IDs are preserved byte-for-byte; both exploratory targets remain unreviewed and outside the gate.
Original 85 and expanded 109 contract denominators are separate.
Zero audited overlaps for the 12 month mappings do not establish a clean held-out corpus or population accuracy. Existing loanword overlap disclosures remain historical.
Gregorian full month words only; no Bikram Sambat conversion, shortened month aliases, suffix/compound inference, digit/ordinal/gender rules or new public API.
No timing or population accuracy claim. Raw external data and private reviewer sheets are not redistributed.
Desktop Chromium interaction check with narrow viewport does not establish mobile keyboard, assistive technology or cross-browser support.
